# Gallery

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_docs.py from the source. Do not edit by hand: change the code and re-run it. -->

Each sheet is the asymmetric test block from the test suite (40 × 30 × 20 with a corner notch and a through-hole), rendered by the generator itself when the docs site is built. Click a sheet for the full-size SVG.

## default

The default sheet: front, top and right views in third-angle positions, the isometric at the main scale, overall dimensions.

[![default](gallery/default.png)](gallery/default.svg)

## all-six

`views:` with all six orthographic views and the isometric.

[![all-six](gallery/all-six.png)](gallery/all-six.svg)

## top-only

`views: [top]`: one view on its own, centred and drawn as large as a standard scale allows.

[![top-only](gallery/top-only.png)](gallery/top-only.svg)

## iso-fill

`isometric: fill`: the isometric fills the space right of the views.

[![iso-fill](gallery/iso-fill.png)](gallery/iso-fill.svg)

## iso-only

`views: [isometric]`: the isometric alone.

[![iso-only](gallery/iso-only.png)](gallery/iso-only.svg)

## plain

`style: {aged: false, stamp: false, winks: false}`: drafting only.

[![plain](gallery/plain.png)](gallery/plain.svg)

## grid

`style: {grid: true}`: the faint 10 mm graph grid over the aged paper.

[![grid](gallery/grid.png)](gallery/grid.svg)
